default_in_repayment.text: In terms of Information and explanation sought by us, and given by the company and books of accounts and records examined by us in the normal course of audit and to the best of our knowledge and belief, we state that there has not been any default in repayment of any loans or other borrowings for any principal amount due or any interest thereon.

fraud.text:
a.    Based upon the audit procedures performed and the information and explanations given by the management, we report that no fraud by the company or no fraud on the company by any person has been reported during the year.

b.    As there is no fraud in terms of section 143(12) of the act, so reporting in the form ADT-4 during the year by an auditor was not required to file.
c. In terms of section-177(9) of the act, it is mandatory for the said company to establish vigil mechanism set in the company, however based upon the audit procedure performed and the information and explanations given by the management of the company we have not come across any whistle-blower complaints during the year.

statutory_dues.text:
a. According to information and explanations given to us and on the basis of our examination of the books of account, and records, the Company has been generally regular in depositing undisputed statutory dues including Goods and service tax, Provident Fund, Employees State Insurance, Income-Tax, Sales tax, Service Tax, Duty of Customs, Duty of Excise, Cess and any other statutory dues with the appropriate authorities. 

As per information and explanations given to us, and based on verification of documents and records, no undisputed amounts payable in respect of the above were in arrears as at March 31, 2025 for a period of more than six months from the date on which they become payable.

timeline.summary: Krishival Foods expanded its Melt N Mellow ice cream cold chain by deploying 15,490 deep freezers as of March 31, 2026.
Krishival Foods Limited will host a Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call on May 4, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 6:30 PM IST, with Chairman Sujit Bangar, CEO Abhishek Puranik, and CEO Nana Mhaske.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹102.07 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹5.44 Cr.
Krishival Foods submitted its statement of non-deviation for ₹34.99 Cr raised via rights issue for FY26.

Krishival Foods filed a revised first monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, correcting capex utilisation to ₹5.76 Cr from ₹5.80 Cr; ₹34.99 Cr of the ₹99.99 Cr rights issue had been received.
Krishival Foods Limited held Q4 FY26 Earnings Conference Call on May 4, 2026, at 5:30 PM IST with audio recording available via link.
Krishival Foods Limited held Q4 FY26 Earnings Conference Call on May 4, 2026, at 5:30 PM IST with **Suresh Gawande** and **Rahul Gawande** via virtual mode.
Krishival Foods held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 4, 2026, reporting 48% YoY revenue growth to ₹304.41 Cr.
Krishival Foods reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹88.96 Cr, up 80% YoY, with Melt N Mellow ice cream segment revenue at ₹51.57 Cr, achieving EBITDA profitability ahead of plan.
Krishival Foods converted 5,51,289 partly paid shares after receiving ₹10.75 crore in final call proceeds.
